title: 第22章 解决二第23章 余波一
slug: 无限魔神没流量怎么下载
content_zh:
眼前黑红之色交错，温热的液体顺着面颊向下流淌。
薛雾只觉大半张脸都麻木，没有了知觉。
本能地想要挣扎。
然而，迎接他的又是一击重拳。
嘭！
面骨传出了不堪重负的骨折声。
脑鸣耳鸣一瞬间全部涌了上来。
然后，掐住他脖子的那一只手蓦地收紧，扣进了他颈侧。
这一瞬，薛雾再也坚持不住。
眼前骤然发黑，耳中嗡鸣如潮，身上的力气像被抽空的沙袋般溃散，整个人瞬间失去了意识。
看着手中双眼泛白，满脸是血，四肢抽搐的薛雾。
胡隆神色平静，随手将其丢在了地上。
“没想到，还挺耐打的。”
人脖子上的血管很多，其中一些特殊部位受到按压，重击，可以让人迅速的失去反抗力。
比如颈动脉窦。
触发后会产生强烈的神经反射，导致血压骤降、心率锐减，产生瞬间头晕、无力、恶心、甚至短暂意识丧失。
原本胡隆虽然得益于大师级的徒手格斗，脑海中有这方面的记忆，但毕竟没有实际操作过，不太可能一下成功。
现如今之所以这般一下做到。
是胡隆在这段时间拿薛雾的父母尝试练习一番后得出的成果。
难怪说实践才是唯一真理，这句话一点也不假。

不过抛开大师级的徒手格斗这门技能不谈，从某些方面也的确可以证明胡隆很有天赋。
看着昏厥过去的薛雾，胡隆随手拿起一块抹布，狠狠塞进他嘴里。
紧接着，他目光一转，抄起旁边的一根钢筋，朝薛雾身上抡去。
嘭！嘭！嘭！
沉闷的击打声接连响起，他简直把薛雾当成了沙袋。
别看胡隆表现的还算正常。
但说到底，他本身也只是一个普通人。
这段时间，突然的穿越，换了个世界，又遇到了那‘鬼东西’，这一切的一切带来的心理压力与恐惧让他寝食难安。
只是他强大的自控力让自己没有表现出来，但是并非代表他没有这方面的情绪。
此刻，见到正主，胡隆心中积压已久的情绪终于发泄在了棍棒之下。
不过他没有朝着对方头打，免得直接将其打死。
一连抽了十几下，直到浑身畅快，心中的郁结之气散了，他才停下手来。
“呃……”
这时，躺在地上的薛雾硬生生被打得清醒了过来。
他脑子有些混沌。
肿成猪头的眼睛勉强睁开一丝缝隙，入眼所见，白炽灯下。
在他面前站着一络腮胡大汉，戴着手套的手正握着一根沾血的钢筋，居高临下，目光平静的望着他。
甚至他还在一旁看到他的父母也同样被绑着丢在了一旁，嘴巴都被塞上布条躺在那里一动不动，看样子是昏过去了。
这让他一下回想起来发生了什么事情。
连忙想要有所动作。

然而轻轻一动，身上顿时剧烈的疼痛传来，双手双脚像是都不是自己的，除了痛已经没了知觉。
如果现在有一面镜子，他就会发现自己已经肿成了猪头。
四肢都呈现出不同程度的弯曲。
content_en:
Black and red colors intertwined before his eyes, and warm liquid flowed down his cheeks.
Xue Wu felt that most of his face was numb and unconscious.
Instinctively want to struggle.
However, he was greeted with another heavy blow.
Bang!
There was an overwhelming sound of fractures in the facial bones.
The ringing in the brain and ears all came flooding back in an instant.
Then, the hand holding his neck suddenly tightened and clasped into the side of his neck.
At this moment, Xue Wu could no longer hold on.
His eyes suddenly turned black, his ears buzzed like a tide, the strength in his body collapsed like an empty sandbag, and he lost consciousness in an instant.
Looking at Xue Wu in his hand, his eyes were white, his face was covered in blood, and his limbs were twitching.
Hu Long looked calm and threw it on the ground.
"I didn't expect it to be quite durable."
There are many blood vessels in the human neck, and if some special parts are pressed or hit hard, people can quickly lose resistance.
Such as the carotid sinus.
When triggered, a strong neural reflex will occur, leading to a sudden drop in blood pressure, a sharp decrease in heart rate, instant dizziness, weakness, nausea, and even temporary loss of consciousness.
Originally, although Hu Long benefited from his master-level unarmed combat and had memories of this in his mind, he had never done it in practice and was unlikely to succeed at once.
The reason why I can do it now is like this.
It was the result of Hu Long's practice with Xue Wu's parents during this period.
No wonder it is said that practice is the only truth. This sentence is not false at all.
But putting aside the skill of master-level unarmed combat, it can indeed be proved that Hu Long is very talented in some aspects.
Looking at Xue Wu who had fainted, Hu Long picked up a rag and stuffed it into his mouth.
Then, he turned his eyes, picked up a steel bar next to him, and swung it towards Xue Wu.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Dull blowing sounds sounded one after another, and he simply regarded Xue Wu as a sandbag.
Don't look at Hu Long's performance as normal.
But in the end, he is just an ordinary person.
During this period, he suddenly traveled through time, changed the world, and met that "ghost" again. The psychological pressure and fear caused by all of this made him unable to sleep or eat well.
It's just that his strong self-control prevented him from showing it, but it doesn't mean that he doesn't have this emotion.
At this moment, seeing the real master, Hu Long's long-standing emotions were finally vented under the stick.
However, he did not hit the opponent on the head to avoid killing him directly.
He pumped it for more than a dozen times in a row until his whole body was relaxed and the stagnation in his heart was gone, and then he stopped.
"Uh..."
At this time, Xue Wu, who was lying on the ground, was beaten to consciousness.
His mind was a little confused.
The swollen pig-headed eyes barely opened a crack, and what they saw was under the incandescent lamp.
Standing in front of him was a bearded man, holding a bloody steel bar in his gloved hand, looking down at him with calm eyes.
He even saw his parents being tied up and thrown aside. Their mouths were stuffed with cloth and they were lying there motionless. They seemed to have passed out.
This made him remember what happened.
He quickly wanted to take action.
However, as soon as he moved slightly, severe pain suddenly came from his body. His hands and feet seemed to be not his own, and he had no feeling except for the pain.
If there was a mirror now, he would find that he had swollen into a pig's head.
All limbs exhibit varying degrees of bending.
